name: Prone Heel Squeeze
summary: Lying face down with knees bent and wide and heels together, the heels press into each other to switch the glutes on.
steps: Lie face down, forehead on the hands.
Bend the knees, let them open, and bring the heels together.
Breathe out to press the heels together firmly.

layers.title: Float the thighs
layers.text: Lift the knees a little off the mat.

layers.title: Bend and stretch
layers.text: Straighten and bend the knees while lifted.

cautions.note: Pad under the knees; keep the bend comfortable.

cues:
Pubic bone stays on the mat.
The lower back stays switched off while the knees are down.
A firm press, not a clench.
Belly drawn up lightly.

review.note: Draft entry written for OpenPilates. Needs review by a qualified Pilates instructor before teaching from it.
